description: This file contains assembly code implementing an interrupt service routine (ISR) handler for the MCI (Memory Card Interface) on an AT91 microcontroller. It manages context saving/restoring, interacts with the Advanced Interrupt Controller (AIC), and calls a C handler function.

methods.name: AT91F_ASM_MCI_Handler
methods.description: Assembly routine serving as the interrupt handler for the MCI, managing context switching and invoking the C handler.
